note: Conduint Shield rules. hashes: sha256 -> name. names/scripts: regex rules on file names and script text. content: pieces joined and searched in the first 64 KB. sev: high = block, med = flag, low = info. apk: rules for the APK inspector. perms: permission name (short, without android.permission.) -> label and severity. combos: all listed permissions together. brands: an app label that matches re must have a package id that matches ok. certs: sha256 of a signing certificate -> name (high, blocks).

names.label: Double extension: a document name hiding a program
The name uses a hidden reversing character to fake its extension
Windows program (does nothing on Android, but is often used to spread malware)

scripts.label: Runs a hidden (encoded) command in the shell
Deletes everything in your home folder or storage
Fork bomb: locks up the device
Writes raw data over a storage device
Opens a remote shell to another machine
Downloads code and runs it straight away
Downloads a file and then runs it
Reads or sends private phone data (SMS, calls, contacts or clipboard)

perms.name: READ_SMS
perms.label: Can read your text messages (including 2-step codes)

perms.name: RECEIVE_SMS
perms.label: Can intercept incoming text messages (including 2-step codes)

perms.name: SEND_SMS
perms.label: Can send text messages without asking (can run up your bill)

perms.name: BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE
perms.label: Has an accessibility service: it can read the screen and tap for you, the main tool of banking trojans

perms.name: BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE
perms.label: Can read every notification, including 2-step codes

perms.name: BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN
perms.label: Can become a device administrator (can lock or wipe the phone and block removal)

perms.name: READ_CALL_LOG
perms.label: Can read your call history

perms.name: PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS
perms.label: Can see and redirect the calls you make

perms.name: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
perms.label: Can draw over other apps (used for fake login screens)

perms.name: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
perms.label: Can ask to install other apps

perms.name: REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES
perms.label: Can ask to remove other apps

perms.name: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
perms.label: Can see and change every file on the phone

perms.name: RECORD_AUDIO
perms.label: Can record sound with the microphone

perms.name: READ_CONTACTS
perms.label: Can read your contacts

perms.name: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
perms.label: Can track your location while the app is closed

perms.name: BIND_VPN_SERVICE
perms.label: Can route all your network traffic through itself (VPN)

perms.name: WRITE_SETTINGS
perms.label: Can change system settings

perms.name: DISABLE_KEYGUARD
perms.label: Can turn off the lock screen

perms.name: READ_PHONE_NUMBERS
perms.label: Can read your phone number

perms.name: READ_PHONE_STATE
perms.label: Can read the phone state and identity

perms.name: CAMERA
perms.label: Can use the camera

perms.name: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
perms.label: Can see your exact location

perms.name: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
perms.label: Can see every app you have installed

perms.name: RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
perms.label: Starts by itself when the phone starts

perms.name: KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES
perms.label: Can stop other apps running in the background

combos.label: Can intercept texts and send data out: the pattern used to steal 2-step codes
Can read texts and send data out: the pattern used to steal 2-step codes
Can read notifications and send data out: the pattern used to steal 2-step codes
Accessibility plus drawing over other apps: the core of banking trojans
Starts on its own, covers other apps and can install more apps: typical of droppers
